title: Binance Futures Will Launch Coin-Margined ICX & ALGO Perpetual Contracts with Up to 20X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch Coin-Margined ICX and ALGO perpetual contracts with up to 20x leverage. The launching schedule is as below. ICXUSD Perpetual Contract will be launched at 2022-03-14 03:30 AM (UTC). ALGOUSD Perpetual Contract will be launched at 2022-03-15 03:30 AM (UTC). Please note: ICX and ALGO perpetual contracts are Coin-Margined futures contracts that use ICX and ALGO as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-20x leverage.
